claim: The transmitted-light lamp, Micro-Manager device DiaLamp, reports two properties, State and Intensity, both readable at load; on 2026-09-24, with no software having set them, they read State "0" and Intensity "2100".
validity_conditions: Event 17 of the run. Both values are strings as the adapter returned them and are recorded as settings read back, not as quantities: the unit of Intensity is not stated by the adapter, and what State "0" means for light is not established by this reading -- nothing measured light that day. The abort commands this lamp to State "0"; that it then emits nothing has been seen only on mock, which echoes the value it is given. Read back in a preparatory run with no plan, which wrote nothing to any device. A device's report of itself may enter citing such a run (11-21 condition 4 as narrowed at 20a688b), graded as an observation by this system, E1. Not a value of any registered observable. KNOWLEDGE, NOT POLICY: what the device reports, never a limit and never permission to command it.
